history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. Saurath Sabha Gachhi is a 22-acre mango orchard at Saurath village, about 6 km northeast of Madhubani town — the venue of Saurath Sabha, the centuries-old annual marriage assembly of Maithil Brahmins held in the Hindu months of Jyestha–Aasadh. Hereditary Panjikar genealogists authenticate family lineages (up to seven generations) before matches are fixed. Sources conflict on age: reports call the tradition 700 years old or a 15th-century royal/land grant (one account says 22 bigha, about 9 acres, donated by the Maharaja of Darbhanga). Once drawing lakhs of participants, it is now largely ceremonial (inaugurated 28 May 2025) and in sharp decline. A Madhaweshwar Nath Mahadev (Shiva) temple stands within the campus. Coordinates are for Saurath village and are approximate.
